# Dental Home Kanpur

> Dental Home Kanpur is a dental and maxillofacial surgery clinic led by Dr. Ankur Rathaur, located in Kakadeo, Kanpur, India. The clinic offers general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, and specialized maxillofacial surgery services for patients across Kanpur and surrounding neighborhoods.

Dental Home Kanpur provides comprehensive dental care including routine checkups, root canal treatment, tooth extractions, dental implants, braces/orthodontics, teeth whitening, and complex maxillofacial and oral surgery procedures. The clinic is run by Dr. Ankur Rathaur, a maxillofacial surgeon, and serves patients from Kakadeo and nearby areas of Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.
